claims: Continue mechanical ventilation in CPAP/PSV mode with PS 8 cmH2O, PEEP 5 cmH2O, and FiO2 30%, targeting the recorded plateau pressure and minute ventilation goals.
Continue norepinephrine infusion at the current rate and titrate to maintain arterial blood pressure within the set alarm limits (low 90 mmHg), given recent systolic readings of 89-126 mmHg.
Continue the active antibiotic regimen (vancomycin, cefepime, ampicillin) and acyclovir as ordered, with attention to the positive urine benzodiazepine screen and CSF results.
Monitor arterial line blood pressure, heart rate, SpO2, and respiratory rate continuously against configured alarm limits.
Monitor ventilator parameters (tidal volume, minute volume, peak and plateau pressures, spontaneous respiratory rate) and reassess for weaning readiness.
Reassess sedation using Richmond-RAS and CAM-ICU, with a goal RASS of -1, and manage agitation (current RASS +1) accordingly.
Monitor blood glucose with finger sticks and treat per protocol, given glucose readings of 90-145 mg/dL.
Monitor serum electrolytes including magnesium (1.6 mg/dL) and potassium (3.5 mEq/L) and replete as needed.
Maintain fall and pressure injury precautions (bedfast, high fall risk, Braden score indicating risk) including repositioning and skin care.
Continue subcutaneous heparin for venous thromboembolism prophylaxis as ordered.
